name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm already an n8n user. I build production workflows in n8n, Make, and Zapier for clients at Solenzo: OAuth and API-key credentials, webhooks, REST API calls, JavaScript and Python code nodes, and LLM API steps, including an audit workflow with rubric-graded AI output that has run on 180+ businesses. When an integration breaks, I'm the one reading the JSON and fixing it, so conversations with IT and engineering stakeholders about APIs and automation architecture are familiar ground.

The customer side is where I spent my career before that. At Birdeye I watched partner usage closely, stepped in when an account started to slip, and retained all but one of 15 to 20 partners. At Wix I carried up to 25 accounts at once and launched 25+ a month at 110% of my implementation target, and at Accelo I guided onboarding and API integrations with C-suite stakeholders.

To be direct: my accounts have been small and mid-sized businesses, not large enterprises. What I bring is the rare combination of running the customer relationship and actually building in your product. I'm in Colorado and glad to work West Coast hours. Open to a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
